Mahanadi Steel Corporation 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Gujarat · IN
 
 No. CC/61/2023/032 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Institutional Building - Gujarat Pkg-32" (buildings), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp.
 Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 07 Dec 2023 at a gross executed value
 of Rs. 1457.00 Lakh (Rupees 14.57 Crore Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the workmanship conforming to the
 technical specifications forming part of the contract. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Deepa Chatterjee. This certificate is issued for record and for submission with
 future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Mahanadi Steel Corporation
